hook_text: There is a power station that needs no coal, no water, no decade of construction — and it switches on the moment you stop wasting.
clip_script: The usual drawing of South Africa's energy problem is a tap that gives too little: not enough power stations. Draw it instead as a leaking bucket. Plenty of electricity pours in at the top, but thin streams escape through holes in every side — windows that leak heat, filament bulbs from another century, geysers standing naked in cold roofs, factory motors wheezing at half efficiency, offices lit at midnight for nobody. Ask the money question: is it cheaper to build another dam to fill the bucket faster, or to plug the holes? A new power station swallows hundreds of billions of rand and roughly a decade. Hole-plugging — insulation, LEDs, geyser timers, modern motors — costs a small fraction, starts working within months, and emits nothing whatsoever. That is why efficiency carries the name invisible power station: it is the station the country never has to build, because the demand it would have supplied has been deleted. Learn the champion sentence by heart: the unit of electricity you never use is the cheapest and cleanest unit there is. And plugging holes is no longer a private choice — foreign customs desks have begun weighing the coal smoke baked into products, so every leak in the bucket nudges up the price of South African steel, wine and fruit overseas. A greener economy just means the economy keeps growing while the leaks keep shrinking.
visual_style: A hand-drawn bucket filling under a tap while glowing streams leak from labelled holes — draughts, old bulbs, naked geyser, tired motor; each hole plugged with a satisfying click as an LED, blanket and timer icon appears; a phantom power station fading away as the leaks close; a customs stamp weighing smoke inside a steel beam.
mood: Practical, sly and empowering — the cheat code hiding in plain sight.
pacing: Quick reveal of the bucket, rhythmic hole-plugging beats, a slow underline on the champion sentence.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and learn all three spanners that plug the bucket.
